description: Fresh EN solar microgrid operations admission domain.

units.title: Grid islanding
units.text: When utility voltage moves outside the permitted operating band, the microgrid controller opens the point-of-common-coupling breaker and the battery inverter establishes the island. Reconnection waits until utility conditions are stable and the synchronization check passes.

units.title: Battery reserve
units.text: Before a forecast grid outage, operators maintain at least 25 percent battery state of charge so the controller has enough stored energy to form the island and pick up critical loads if utility power disappears.

units.title: Generator start condition
units.text: The backup generator starts only when battery state of charge is below 15 percent and site demand has exceeded the combined solar and battery capability for five continuous minutes.

units.title: Black-start sequence
units.text: During black start, the battery inverter first establishes the local voltage and frequency reference. The controller then energizes the critical feeder and later reconnects available solar generation.

units.title: Commissioning export example
units.text: A commissioning worksheet uses 100 kW as a temporary export test point to demonstrate the limiter. The example value is not the permanent site export limit and must not be copied into the operating configuration.

units.title: Inverter interface
units.text: The controller exchanges status and setpoints with compatible inverters over Modbus TCP. The operating procedure does not prescribe a specific inverter manufacturer.
